messages:
ida: Heads up — I'm seeing a policy mismatch on the private control plane for a customer. New RBAC role 'private_admin' appears to allow SUDO actions but those actions aren't landing in audit logs. :grimacing:

mike: can you paste the error/log?

ida: pasted snippet from control-plane: "permission denied: audit.write missing for role private_admin". Customer reported admin actions not appearing in the audit index.

raj: that's odd — private_admin should inherit audit.write. Which rollout bucket did this hit (dedicated vs on-prem)?

ida: on-prem. We did the role refactor last night that tightened a bunch of derived roles. Suspect an inheritance bug where audit permissions were accidentally dropped.

linh: if audit.write is missing, the KMS-encrypted audit blob upload can fail silently. We saw similar in staging when the sink SA lost kms:Decrypt.

ida: repro steps I ran: ssh into control-plane -> run `sudo list-activities` -> command succeeds, but aggregator shows no entry. Control-plane logs show a 403 from audit-sink: "kms:Decrypt denied for arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abc-..."

mike: 403 from KMS decrypt points to the audit-sink service account not having kms:Decrypt in key policy or IAM. Did the refactor move service account bindings?

ida: yes, the refactor consolidated service account roles under `priv-mgr`. I think the audit-sink SA got omitted from the key policy when we applied the new modules.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed — rbacs/v2 rolled out to 3/4 clusters (at 2024-11-02T03:24:11Z)

raj: we should avoid further gaps. Recommend canary rollback on the affected cluster + quick policy patch to KMS to restore decrypt for audit-sink SA.

ida: agreed. Quick mitigation: patch KMS key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/audit-sink` and hold rollback until we confirm no more dropped events.

linh: also file an IR ticket — missing audit events is a compliance issue. This should be Sev2.

ida: creating ticket now — SEV2-3177. I'll attach logs and repro steps.

mike: I'll prepare the KMS key patch and a canary rollback plan. ping me and I'll execute.

linh: double-check VPC allowlist/egress rules too — on-prem control plane uses a distinct NAT and we sometimes block encryption endpoints by mistake.

raj: good call. I'll validate network connectivity from control-plane -> kms and control-plane -> audit-sink (tcp/443).

ida: FYI I just messaged support: @support please hold external comms; telling them we're investigating and will update shortly.

support-bot: Support notified: ticket SEV2-3177 created and assigned to eng-security.

mike: after patching, we should run a backfill query and confirm events for the window are present. Also add a short automated test to catch this inheritance edge-case.

ida: noted. ETA for KMS patch and confirmation: ~45m. I'll update this thread with timestamps and whether rollback was needed.

linh: thanks — also log the change in the RBAC migration doc and flag for postmortem. We want to avoid silent audit gaps in future. :white_check_mark:
